- Yogurt cup: about 130 kcal
- Orange juice (about 200 ml): about 90 kcal

- Toast, 5 slices at about 80 kcal each: about 400 kcal
- Jam, 5 portions at about 25 kcal each: about 125 kcal
- Butter, 3 portions at about 36 kcal each: about 110 kcal

The leftover figure is a guess. I assume the person leaves some toast, some jam and butter, and perhaps part of the yogurt. That comes to about 250 kcal left over, so about 920 kcal eaten.

- Carbohydrate: about 135 g
